topic: Turning a photo of a handwritten holiday card address list into a CSV spreadsheet
text:
If your holiday card addresses live in an old address book, one photo of the page can become a tidy list you can actually use.

"Turn this photo of my address list into a table with Name, Street, City, State and ZIP. Mark anything you can't read with a question mark. Give it to me as a CSV file."

Tap the plus button to add the photo. The CSV opens in Excel or Google Sheets, so you can print labels later.

How many cards do you usually send?
